summary: Iteration 35: Referral Push Notifications & MinhasIndicacoes Component - All 14 backend tests PASSED (100%). All frontend features verified working correctly.

issues: Copy to clipboard shows 'Erro ao copiar' toast in test environment (clipboard API permission issue - works in production)

Owner sees: referral code (REF-CSAC0455), copy button, WhatsApp share, full indicados list
Visitor sees: only public data (count, indicados list) without referral code
Push notifications created correctly when someone registers with referral code
Notification format: '🎉 Nova indicação!' with message '[Nome] se cadastrou usando seu código de indicação!'
Embaixador badge threshold (5 indicações) correctly implemented in both frontend and backend
GET /api/indicacao/atleta/{id}/publico endpoint working for public profile data
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test user (TEST_NotifTest_*) during notification test which triggered a new push notification
